hook: A gene therapy let a drug quiet brain cells and reduce seizures in three epilepsy patients.
summary: News report on the first clinical use of a chemogenetic strategy, in which engineered brain cells respond to a drug that dampens their activity. A team in China treated three patients with epilepsy. Only three patients were treated, so safety and benefit remain unproven.
title: Novel gene therapy lets drug dampen brain cell activity, reducing seizures.
